title: Give both workflows an explicit least-privilege permissions block
problem: ci.yml and skill-release.yml do not declare permissions, so GITHUB_TOKEN gets the repository default, which is write. A pull request from a fork runs untrusted code against that token. Nothing here deploys today, but the blast radius of a future mistake is set by this default, not by intent.
deliverables: permissions: contents: read at workflow level in both files
Any job that genuinely needs more rights declares them on that job, with a comment saying why
acceptance: Both workflows declare an explicit permissions block
No job gains a permission it did not already exercise
CI still runs verify, scan and conformance to success on a PR
The change adds no new workflow

required: the resulting workflow file excerpt showing the permissions block
a CI run link or pasted job result
